section_header: STEERING — Steering Column Assembly with Tilt Steering
title: DISASSEMBLY OF STEERING COLUMN ASSEMBLY AND TILT MECHANISM
subtitle: (See page SR-5)

substeps.label: (a)
substeps.text: Place the ignition key at the ACC position.

substeps.label: (b)
substeps.text: Push down the stop key with a thin rod, and pull out the key cylinder.

content.description: Illustration showing the removal of ignition key cylinder from the steering column, with hand manipulating the cylinder mechanism

substeps.label: (a)
substeps.text: Fully tilt the main shaft upward.

substeps.label: (b)
substeps.text: Pry the spring and remove the cord and spring.

content.description: Illustration showing hands removing tension springs and cords from the steering column assembly, with prying action depicted

content.heading: DISCONNECT INTERMEDIATE SHAFT AND MAIN SHAFT

substeps.label: (a)
substeps.text: Place matchmarks on the intermediate shaft and universal joint.

substeps.label: (d)
substeps.text: Separate the tilt mechanism from the column tube.

content.description: Illustration showing the disconnection of intermediate shaft and main shaft, with hands working on the universal joint and bracket bolts

content.heading: DISCONNECT UPPER BRACKET FROM TILT STEERING SUPPORT

substeps.label: (b)
substeps.text: Remove the three bolts and disconnect the bracket from the support.

content.description: Illustration showing hands removing bolts from the upper bracket and tilt steering support assembly
